loginMfa.title: Confirm it's you
loginMfa.totpBody: Enter the code from the authenticator app on your phone.
loginMfa.smsBody: We sent a text message with a code to {phone}.
loginMfa.smsBodyNoPhone: We sent a text message with a code to your phone.
loginMfa.smsPending: We'll send a code to your phone by text message.
loginMfa.recoveryBody: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you signed up. Each code works once.
loginMfa.recoveryInvalid: Enter the recovery code exactly as you saved it.
loginMfa.useSms: Send a code by text message
loginMfa.smsWait: Didn't get the code? You can ask for a new one in {time}
loginMfa.smsReady: Didn't get the code? You can ask for a new one now.
